title: How much experience do you have?
goal_hi: Apne experience, design/development work aur team handling ke baare me batana.

forms.positive: I have three years of experience in web development.
forms.negative: I don't have much experience with backend.
forms.question: How many years of experience do you have?

pattern.note_hi: Years ke pehle number, experience ke pehle 'of'.

examples.en: I have three years of experience in web development.
examples.hi: Mere paas web development me teen saal ka experience hai.

examples.en: I have experience with responsive design.
examples.hi: Mere paas responsive design ka experience hai.

examples.en: I manage a small development team.
examples.hi: Main ek chhoti development team manage karta hoon.

examples.en: I handle client calls and project updates.
examples.hi: Main client calls aur project updates handle karta hoon.

words.example_en: I have three years of experience.
words.example_hi: Mere paas teen saal ka experience hai.
Main responsive design par kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.title: Client asks about experience
dialogue.context_hi: Client aapke experience ke baare me poochta hai.

scenario.title_hi: Client aapke experience ke baare me poochta hai
scenario.setting_hi: Naya client project start karne se pehle sawaal poochta hai.

turns.prompt_en: How many years of experience do you have?
turns.model_en: I have three years of experience in web development.

turns.prompt_en: What do you handle in a project?
turns.model_en: I handle design, development, and client calls.

turns.prompt_en: Have you managed a team before?
